title: Build Your World Backward

voice.direction: Natural, confident documentary narrator revealing a creative secret. Intrigued on the hook, curious and unhurried on the three clues, a beat of weight on 'what mistake brought them down?', settled and certain on 'work backward', conversational on the CTA. No trailer voice.

lines.text: Want to create an ancient civilization?
A shattered tower might reveal its ambitions.
Strange machines could expose its technology.
Faded symbols might uncover what its people worshipped.
Then ask yourself: what did they achieve, what did they believe, and what mistake brought them down?
Don't just build a civilization from the beginning.
Start with what's left behind, and work backward.
What would your world's oldest ruin look like?

The civilization's architecture: pale ochre sandstone with horizontal bands of green-black basalt, tall tapered towers with stepped crowns, tall keyhole-shaped arches, and a recurring carved spiral-sun relief motif. In the lower-middle of the frame a monumental keyhole-arched gateway, half buried in drifting sand dunes and overgrown with dark green vines and shrubs, a spiral-sun relief above its arch. shots.purpose: Clue 2, technology: a dormant stone-and-bronze mechanism built into the wall, broken but clearly purposeful.
shots.visual: Buried chamber, a beam of sunlight from a broken ceiling falls across a giant mechanism of stone rings and corroded bronze gears around a spiral-sun disc; one ring has fallen into the sand. Dust drifts in the beam; a survey ring traces the disc.
shots.lighting: Dark chamber, one hard sunbeam; verdigris against ochre.
shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. Inside a partially buried ancient chamber of a lost civilization, dim and dusty. The civilization's architecture: pale ochre sandstone walls with horizontal bands of green-black basalt, keyhole-shaped arches, and a recurring carved spiral-sun relief motif. Built into the far wall is a huge dormant machine of interlocking carved stone rings and verdigris-green corroded bronze gears, arranged like a giant astronomical mechanism around a central spiral-sun disc, with bronze rods and channels running into the stone. Several gears are cracked, one ring has fallen and lies tilted in drifted sand on the floor. A single narrow beam of sunlight falls diagonally from a broken opening in the ceiling and illuminates the mechanism's intricate construction, dust glittering in the beam. Unfamiliar but clearly purposeful ancient engineering, not science fiction, no glowing lights, no screens. No people. Painterly realism, atmospheric perspective, 35mm anamorphic look, soft film grain, original architecture. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.

shots.purpose: Clue 3, belief: walls of repeating sacred symbols lead to a statue holding the same spiral sun seen on the gate and the machine.
shots.visual: Long banded passage, rows of eroded spiral-sun, eye and wave symbols; at the end, framed by keyhole arches, a seated statue holding a spiral-sun disc. Survey ring on the disc.

shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. A long narrow ceremonial passage of a lost civilization, seen in one-point perspective. The civilization's architecture: pale ochre sandstone with horizontal bands of green-black basalt, keyhole-shaped arches, and a recurring carved spiral-sun relief motif. Both tall walls are covered with rows of repeating eroded carved symbols: spiral suns, stylized eyes and wave shapes, worn faint with traces of faded red ochre and blue pigment. At the far end of the passage, framed by a keyhole arch, a monumental seated stone statue of a robed figure holds a large spiral-sun disc on its lap, lit by warm sunlight from above. Sand drifted along the floor, roots and vines creeping over the walls, shafts of light and dust. No people. Sacred, quiet, mysterious. shots.transition: Hard cut on 'Then' to the broken aqueduct.
shots.music: G major over the pulse: something sacred.

shots.purpose: The fall: one readable clue (the great aqueduct broke, the fields below are dust), then the three questions that turn ruins into a story.
shots.visual: A colossal aqueduct of keyhole arches across a dry valley; a whole span has collapsed. A dashed rust line shows where the channel once ran. THEIR ACHIEVEMENTS ↓ THEIR BELIEFS ↓ Their final mistake. lands word by word.

shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. The remains of a colossal ancient aqueduct of a lost civilization crossing a dry desert valley. The civilization's architecture: pale ochre sandstone with horizontal bands of green-black basalt, tall keyhole-shaped arches, and a recurring carved spiral-sun relief motif on the piers. The aqueduct strides across the middle of the frame on enormous tiers of keyhole arches, but in the center a whole span has collapsed: a huge cracked gap, the broken stone water channel hanging open at both edges, tumbled blocks piled in the dry riverbed below. Old dark water stains run down the stone beneath the break. Beyond, the dry cracked valley floor where fields once were, and in the far distance the hazy towers of the abandoned city. Pale hazy sky in the upper third, warm late sun, dust. No people. A clear clue to the civilization's downfall. Painterly realism, atmospheric perspective, 35mm anamorphic look, soft film grain, original architecture. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.

shots.transition: Dissolve to the city, now wide.
shots.music: C minor to B7 with arpeggios at 80 bpm: the tension peak, unresolved on 'down?'.

shots.purpose: The lesson: don't start at the founding; start with the remains. The city's missing crowns and gate are redrawn in amber from what survives.
shots.visual: The opening city in a wide pull-back. 'DON'T build from the beginning' is struck out; amber survey lines rebuild the broken tower tops and the gateway's crown from the ruins upward; 'Build backward.' lands.
shots.camera: Pull back (1.12 to 1.00) to the full city.
shots.lighting: Plate dimmed at the top so the type leads; amber lines glow softly.
shots.onScreenText: 'DON'T' + 'build from the beginning' struck in rust → 'START WITH WHAT'S LEFT' + 'Build backward.'; amber reconstruction lines over the ruins.
shots.transition: Dissolve to the same city at dusk.
shots.music: Resolves C major to G: the idea lands.

shots.purpose: CTA over the same city at dusk with its reconstruction still glowing faintly; ends on the opening frame for a loop.

shots.music: C to E major: warm, open ending; fades fully before the last frame.

lesson: Invent a civilization from the evidence it leaves behind: each ruin implies an achievement, a belief or a mistake.
